description: This file defines a CustomLogger class which handles logging, monitoring, and request/response manipulation in a machine learning inference system. It includes methods for logging events, masking sensitive data such as base64-encoded content, and hooks for integrating with various parts of the system like pre/post call processing and dataset logging.

classes.name: CustomLogger
classes.description: A customizable logging and request/response management class supporting both sync and async operations, with capabilities for masking sensitive data and integrating with monitoring and dataset logging.
